digest_framing: ASCII keto-runtime-code-v1 + LF; for each fixed relative POSIX path in ascending order: UTF-8 path + NUL + lowercase ASCII SHA-256(exact bytes) + LF; SHA-256 of whole framing
startup_behavior: Compute once at start of create_app, before service construction; any missing or unreadable listed file propagates failure; no environment override or filesystem traversal

tests.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_runtime_code_digest.py tests/test_edge_bridge.py tests/test_edge_ed25519.py tests/test_service.py
new_checks: exact ZIP member bytes equal disk framing independent of ZIP member order/metadata
every listed file mutation changes digest; unrelated private-state file does not
status caches per-startup digest despite later disk and env changes; next app sees new bytes; no-store; unchanged auth safety/status semantics; no personal record written

release_boundary: Candidate tests are local only. Final runtime digest must be calculated from the exact release ZIP and compared with serving Azure /status after completed deployment. This is not a live Cloudflare-to-Azure-to-D1 transaction or physical iPhone acceptance.
